name: ST Digital Gabon Nkok Tier III Sovereign Data Center
notes: Inaugurated July 3, 2026 at Nkok near Libreville; Tier III-certified sovereign facility. We Are Tech reports CFA8bn investment, 3,000+ sqm, 92 racks, about 3,000 physical server capacity, and 1 MW installed electrical capacity with planned phased increases.

name: Cybastion-Gabon 20MW Data Center
developer: Cybastion; Government of Gabon; Cisco; Porteo SA
notes: DCD reports a 20MW Libreville data center with a symbolic foundation stone laid and Porteo SA constructing the site; Cybastion's January 28, 2025 release confirms the Gabon strategic investment agreement includes installation of a data center.

name: ACE GABON SA Tier III Carrier Hotel Datacenter
notes: TechAfrica News reports ministerial site inspection of a Tier III carrier hotel under development by state-owned ACE GABON SA; expected completion late November to early December 2026, with 160 racks and more than 1 MW electrical capacity, interconnected with Gabon's submarine cable systems.

name: GABIX POP ACE
notes: Internet exchange/data center point of presence at Angondje, Libreville; sources list GABIX POP ACE as an active facility with GABIX, ANINF, Airtel, GVA, Packet Clearing House, and other connectivity. Capacity not publicly disclosed.

name: GABIX POP CT-1
notes: Internet exchange/data center point of presence in Libreville, listed by Data Center Platform, PeeringDB, and IXPDB/Euro-IX; connected networks include Gabon Telecom, GABIX, ST Digital and GVA. Capacity not publicly disclosed.

name: Airtel Libreville Data Center
notes: Colocation/network facility at Rue Pecqueur, Libreville, listed by Inflect; DataCenterJournal lists Airtel Gabon as a nearby Libreville data center. Capacity not publicly disclosed.
